name: Do nothing
description: Keep current suppliers, orders and production plan. Shows the cost of inaction.

name: Buy early from an alternative supplier
description: Place an emergency order now with the fastest alternative supplier outside the closed area, enough to cover the supply gap plus a safety buffer of the stopped material.

name: Switch part of volume to a second alternative supplier
description: Qualify another alternative supplier outside the closed area and move volume of the stopped material to it. Limited by its weekly capacity.

name: Air-freight critical parts
description: Fly the stopped material from the current supplier through the airport instead of the closed port. Limited by booked air cargo space.

name: Raise selling prices 5%
description: Pass the higher input and freight cost to customers. Does not fix the supply gap.

name: Cut purchase orders
description: Cancel open purchase orders in line with the demand drop, after the supplier notice period.

name: Slow production (cut shifts)
description: Drop overtime and one shift so variable conversion cost falls with volume.

upfront_cost.note: shift change and contract labour release

name: Discount 10% to clear stock
description: Cut prices 10% to win back volume and use up stock. Margin per board falls.

name: Renegotiate supplier contracts
description: Negotiate 5% lower input prices for purchases after the negotiation period.
